bagPolicy.summary: Paramount Theatre does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: The 5th Avenue Theatre does not have its own parking lot, but there are several pay lots and metered street parking options nearby. The Union Square Garage and US Bank Center Garage are within walking distance, with free street parking available after 8pm and on Sundays.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Paramount Theatre's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Nearby dining options include Palace Kitchen known for its whole trout and burger royale, Etta's Big Mountain BBQ offering smoked meats and cold draft beers, and Serious Pie famous for its pizzas with blistered crusts. Dahlia Bakery is renowned for its Triple Coconut Cream Pie, and Seatown Rub Shack & Fishery serves Clam & Bacon Chowder and Fish & Chips.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Anyone in your party can ask the ushers and security stationed outside (staff dressed in black) for guidance to t he designated accessible entrance of the Paramount Theatre, located on Pine Street at the intersection with 9 th Avenue.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Paramount Theatre's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Paramount Theatre. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Paramount Theatre. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
